items.summary_en: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model from cactus-compute for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction, shipping as a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in roughly 28MB of RAM. items.summary_zh: iptv-org/iptv是一个在GitHub上开源的IPTV频道集合项目，汇集了全球各地公开可用的电视频道。用户可以通过IP地址直接访问这些频道，无需传统电视设备。该项目依赖于社区贡献持续更新，适合想要免费观看国际电视内容的用户，但也需要注意版权和合法性。
items.summary_en: The iptv-org/iptv project is an open-source collection of publicly available IPTV channels from around the world. It allows users to access thousands of live TV streams directly through IP addresses, bypassing traditional cable or satellite subscriptions. The repository is community-driven and regularly updated, making it a valuable resource for cord-cutters and international viewers. However, users should be aware of potential copyright issues and ensure they comply with local laws. This project solves the problem of accessing diverse television content without expensive subscriptions, but it operates in a legal gray area.

items.title: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.description: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run — clone, customize, ship.
items.author: Shubhamsaboo
items.summary_zh: 这个GitHub仓库收集了超过100个AI智能体和RAG应用，全部都是可以直接克隆下来运行的真实项目。无论是想快速上手智能客服还是文档问答系统，你都能在这里找到现成的模板，稍作修改就能部署上线。对于开发者来说，它大大缩短了从想法到产品的距离，尤其适合那些想探索大模型应用但又不想从零搭框架的团队。
items.summary_en: This repository curates over 100 AI agent and RAG applications that are ready to clone, customize, and deploy. Whether you are building a smart customer service bot or a document Q&A system, you can find ready-to-run templates here and tweak them for your needs. It significantly lowers the barrier for developers who want to experiment with large language models without starting from scratch, making it ideal for rapid prototyping and production deployment.

items.title: github/spec-kit
items.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
items.author: github
items.summary_zh: Spec-Kit 是一个帮助开发者快速入门规范驱动开发的开源工具包，提供了丰富的模板和脚手架，让团队能够在设计阶段就围绕规范进行协作，从而减少通信歧义和后期返工。对于希望提升 API 设计质量和开发效率的团队来说，这个工具能够显著降低规范的采用门槛。
items.summary_en: Spec-Kit is a toolkit designed to help developers adopt Spec-Driven Development with minimal friction. It provides templates, scaffolding, and best practices to define specifications before writing code, ensuring teams align on API contracts early. This reduces miscommunication and rework, making it valuable for teams aiming for consistent, high-quality API design. Developers, architects, and DevOps engineers working with microservices or distributed systems will find it particularly useful.

items.title: nodejs/node
items.description: Node.js JavaScript runtime ✨🐢🚀✨
items.author: nodejs
items.summary_zh: Node.js 是一个基于 Chrome V8 引擎的 JavaScript 运行时环境，让开发者可以使用 JavaScript 编写服务端代码。它采用事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，轻量且高效，非常适合构建高性能的网络应用和实时系统。无论是 Web 服务器、命令行工具还是微服务，Node.js 都凭借其庞大的 NPM 生态和跨平台能力，成为现代全栈开发不可或缺的基础设施。
items.summary_en: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine, allowing developers to write server-side code in JavaScript. Its event-driven, non-blocking I/O model makes it lightweight and efficient, ideal for building high-performance network applications and real-time systems. With its vast NPM ecosystem and cross-platform support, Node.js has become an essential foundation for modern full-stack development, powering everything from web servers to command-line tools and microservices.

items.title: microsoft/terminal
items.description: The new Windows Terminal and the original Windows console host, all in the same place!
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 微软将新版 Windows Terminal 与经典控制台宿主整合到一个项目中，开发者可以在一处访问所有的命令行工具。这个统一终端不仅支持多标签页、GPU 加速渲染，还保留了旧控制台的兼容性，让从 PowerShell 到 WSL 的各种环境切换变得丝滑。对于需要频繁操作命令行的程序员、运维和 IT 管理员来说，它解决了多窗口切换的痛点，大幅提升了日常工作效率。
items.summary_en: Microsoft has merged the new Windows Terminal with the original console host into one unified project, giving developers access to all command-line tools from a single place. This unified terminal supports tabs, GPU-accelerated rendering, and backward compatibility with the classic console, making it seamless to switch between PowerShell, CMD, WSL, and more. For programmers, sysadmins, and IT pros who live in the command line, it eliminates the hassle of juggling multiple windows and boosts productivity significantly.

items.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.description: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.
items.author: Graphify-Labs
items.summary_zh: Graphify 是一个 AI 编码助手插件，能够将任意代码文件夹、SQL 模式、R 脚本或 Shell 脚本转化为可视化知识图谱，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等主流工具。它让开发者可以直观地探索项目结构、数据流和依赖关系，尤其适合大型代码库的维护者或需要快速理解他人项目的开发者，显著降低认知负担。
items.summary_en: Graphify is an AI coding assistant skill that transforms any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, or shell scripts into an interactive knowledge graph. By integrating with tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI, it helps developers visualize project structure, data flows, and dependencies without manual inspection. This is especially useful for onboarding new team members, auditing legacy codebases, or quickly grasping complex software architectures.

items.summary_en: LobeHub acts as a Chief Agent Operator, enabling you to hire, schedule, and report on a whole team of AI agents that run 24/7. It orchestrates multiple AI assistants for tasks like customer support, content generation, and data analysis, all from one interface. This solves the pain point of managing disparate AI tools and scales automation, making it ideal for teams looking to streamline their AI workflows.

items.summary_en: This article introduces the concept of 'convex investing' for ordinary people, a strategy where one accepts small, limited losses in exchange for the potential of large, asymmetric gains. It explains convexity in finance and outlines a complete investment pathway. Targeted at retail investors seeking steady long-term returns while avoiding catastrophic losses, it offers a disciplined risk management framework to achieve higher reward-to-risk ratios and navigate market uncertainty.

items.title: Show HN: I replaced a $120k bowling center system with $1,600 in ESP32s
items.author: section33
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者用总价仅1600美元的ESP32微控制器，成功替代了原本价值12万美元的保龄球中心管理系统。这个项目展示了如何利用低成本硬件和巧妙的软件设计，实现计分、传感器联动和用户管理等核心功能。对于小型保龄球馆经营者或喜欢DIY的嵌入式爱好者来说，这是一个极具启发性的低成本自动化改造案例。
items.summary_en: A developer replaced a $120,000 bowling center management system with just $1,600 worth of ESP32 microcontrollers. The project demonstrates how low-cost hardware and clever software design can handle core functions like scoring, sensor integration, and user management. For small bowling alley operators or embedded systems enthusiasts, this is an inspiring example of how to achieve professional-grade automation on a shoestring budget.

items.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
items.author: vincent_s
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3 是一款开源前沿智能模型，旨在将最先进的AI能力开放给更多开发者和研究者。它解决了闭源AI技术垄断的问题，让社区能够自由实验、定制和改进模型。无论是初创公司还是学术机构，都能借助Kimi K3构建自己的智能应用，而无需支付昂贵的授权费用。这种开放策略有望加速AI创新和民主化，使得更广泛的人群能享受到人工智能的成果。
items.summary_en: Kimi K3 is an open-source frontier intelligence model designed to democratize state-of-the-art AI capabilities. It tackles the problem of closed-source AI monopolies by allowing developers and researchers to freely experiment, customize, and improve the model. Startups and academic institutions, in particular, can build their own intelligent applications without expensive licensing fees. This open approach is expected to accelerate AI innovation and democratization, making advanced artificial intelligence accessible to a broader audience.

items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.author: alvis
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是Anthropic最新发布的大型语言模型，据称在推理、代码生成和多轮对话能力上实现了显著飞跃。相比前代，它更擅长处理长上下文和复杂指令，同时保持了较高的安全性。对于需要强大AI助手进行编程、写作及分析的开发者与研究者来说，这代表了一项重要的生产力提升工具。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's latest large language model, boasting major improvements in reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. It handles longer contexts and complex instructions more adeptly while maintaining strong safety guardrails. For developers and researchers seeking a powerful AI assistant for coding, writing, and analysis, this release marks a significant leap in productivity.

items.author: Jrh0203
items.summary_zh: 这个关于电梯的Hacker News讨论帖引发了广泛关注，话题涵盖电梯调度算法、等待时间优化和现代电梯系统的智能控制技术。电梯作为城市垂直交通的核心设施，其运行效率直接影响着人们的生活和工作体验。讨论中提到的智能电梯系统利用AI进行客流预测和动态调度，能够显著减少等待时间，这一看似平凡的设备背后其实藏着丰富的系统工程和算法设计学问。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled "Elevators" has sparked a wide-ranging discussion about the technology behind vertical transportation. The conversation covers elevator dispatch algorithms, wait time optimization, and the emerging role of AI in modern elevator systems. While elevators seem mundane, they represent a fascinating intersection of mechanical engineering, control systems, and operations research. Smart elevator systems now use predictive algorithms and AI to anticipate traffic patterns and dynamically optimize car assignment, significantly reducing wait times in busy buildings. The discussion highlights how an overlooked everyday technology contains deep engineering challenges — from load balancing during rush hour to energy efficiency — making it a compelling topic for engineers and urban technology enthusiasts.

items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face address security incident during model evaluation
items.author: mfiguiere
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 联合披露了一起在模型评估过程中发现的安全事件，涉及潜在的数据泄露风险。两家公司迅速响应，修补了漏洞并加强了评估流程的防护措施。这一事件突显了 AI 模型评估环节的安全性不容忽视，特别是在第三方协作和开放测试环境中，更需要建立严格的安全审查机制。
items.summary_en: OpenAI and Hugging Face disclosed a security incident that occurred during a model evaluation, involving potential data exposure risks. Both companies responded quickly, patching the vulnerability and reinforcing security protocols in the evaluation pipeline. This incident highlights that AI model evaluation stages are not immune to attacks, especially in collaborative and open-testing environments, underscoring the need for rigorous security review processes to protect sensitive data.

items.title: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.author: dwwoelfel
items.summary_zh: 最新的神经科学研究再次证实，手写比打字更能激活大脑中负责学习和记忆的区域。当人们用笔在纸上写字时，手部精细动作与视觉、空间感知的协同作用能加深对信息的处理，从而提升理解和长期记忆。对于学生、创意工作者以及任何希望提高学习效率的人来说，暂时放下键盘、拿起纸笔可能是一种简单而有效的认知训练。
items.summary_en: Recent neuroscience research reaffirms that handwriting engages the brain's learning and memory centers far more deeply than typing. The coordinated fine motor movements, visual feedback, and spatial awareness involved in putting pen to paper enhance information processing, leading to better comprehension and long-term retention. For students, creatives, and anyone seeking to learn more effectively, this suggests that swapping the keyboard for a notebook now and then is a simple yet powerful cognitive boost.

items.title: Kimi-K3 on HuggingFace
items.author: nateb2022
items.summary_zh: Kimi-K3模型正式登陆HuggingFace，这是一款在长文本处理和多轮对话上表现突出的开源大语言模型。它延续了Kimi系列的高效压缩和推理加速技术，使得资源有限的开发者也能轻松部署。此举将推动更多社区在复杂问答和文档分析场景中的应用，进一步降低大模型的使用门槛。
items.summary_en: Kimi-K3, an open-source large language model excelling in long-context understanding and multi-turn conversation, has been released on HuggingFace. Building on Kimi's efficient compression and inference acceleration techniques, it lowers the barrier for developers with limited resources to deploy advanced AI. The release encourages community-driven innovation in complex QA and document analysis, making state-of-the-art language models more accessible to a wider audience.

items.title: OpenSEO
items.description: The open source Ahrefs alternative
items.summary_zh: OpenSEO是一款开源的SEO分析工具，被称作Ahrefs的免费替代品。它提供了网站爬取、关键词研究、外链分析和排名跟踪等核心功能，所有数据都存储在本地，无需订阅付费服务。对于中小企业主、独立博主以及预算有限的网络营销人员来说，OpenSEO让他们能够以零成本获得专业级的搜索引擎优化洞察，帮助他们发现内容机会、监控竞争对手并提升网站流量。开源社区的支持也确保了工具的持续更新和功能扩展。
items.summary_en: OpenSEO is an open-source SEO toolkit marketed as a free alternative to Ahrefs. It includes website crawling, keyword research, backlink analysis, and rank tracking, all running locally so no subscription or third-party service is needed. This empowers small business owners, independent bloggers, and budget-conscious marketers to access professional-level SEO insights at zero cost, helping them discover content opportunities, monitor competitors, and boost organic traffic. Because the community drives its development, OpenSEO is continuously improved and extended, making it a practical choice for those who want full control over their SEO data without recurring fees.

items.title: ClawTeams
items.description: The first goal-driven, proactive AI team for e-commerce
items.summary_zh: ClawTeams 是首个面向电商的目标驱动型主动AI团队。它不像传统工具那样被动等待指令，而是自主分析店铺数据，主动制定运营目标并自动执行，比如优化广告投放、调整库存或提升转化率。对于忙于日常运营的电商卖家来说，ClawTeams就像一位不知疲倦的运营总监，帮助商家在复杂竞争中更高效地达成销售目标。
items.summary_en: ClawTeams is the first goal-driven, proactive AI team built specifically for e-commerce. Instead of waiting for manual commands, it autonomously analyzes store data, sets objectives, and takes actions—like optimizing ad spend, adjusting inventory, or boosting conversions. For busy e-commerce merchants drowning in daily operations, ClawTeams acts like a tireless operations director, helping them hit sales targets more efficiently in a competitive landscape.

items.title: Paradigm
items.description: Turn any goal into a personalized, adaptive learning path.
items.summary_zh: Paradigm 是一款能将任何目标转化为个性化自适应学习路径的工具。它利用AI分析用户的知识水平和学习习惯，动态调整学习计划，帮助用户高效达成既定目标。不同于传统的固定课程，Paradigm能够识别用户的薄弱环节并提供针对性内容。对于想要系统学习新技能或准备考试的人来说，它提供了一种灵活且高效的解决方案，极大提升了学习的自主性和效率。
items.summary_en: Paradigm turns any goal into a personalized, adaptive learning path by leveraging AI to analyze a user's knowledge level and learning habits, dynamically adjusting the plan to help them achieve their target efficiently. Unlike fixed curricula, Paradigm identifies weak spots and delivers tailored content. This makes it a flexible and effective solution for anyone wanting to systematically learn a new skill or prepare for exams, significantly boosting autonomy and learning efficiency.

items.title: Pazi
items.description: Vibe code business operations
items.summary_zh: Pazi 提出了一种全新的业务运营方式——“氛围代码”，即用类似编程的思维和工具来编排业务流程，但操作界面友好直观，不需要传统编码背景。它让团队可以通过定义“氛围”或模式来自动化审批、任务分配等日常操作，使运营更加灵活、透明且易于调整。适合希望用轻量自动化提升效率的业务团队，尤其适合初创公司。
items.summary_en: Pazi introduces 'vibe code' for business operations—a fresh approach that lets you orchestrate workflows using programming-like logic through an intuitive interface, without actual coding. Teams define 'vibes' or patterns to automate approvals, task assignments, and more, making operations flexible, transparent, and easy to tweak. It's ideal for small teams and startups seeking lightweight automation to streamline daily processes without heavy engineering overhead.

items.title: V2Fun
items.description: Generate 3D character with 8K textures and AI motion capture
items.summary_zh: V2Fun是一款面向创作者和游戏开发者的3D角色生成工具，它能通过AI自动生成具有8K纹理的高质量3D角色模型，并内置AI动作捕捉功能，让角色立刻拥有流畅的动画。过去，制作一个类似的精细角色需要专业的建模师、纹理艺术家和动捕设备，耗时数天甚至数周；而V2Fun将这一过程缩短到几分钟，大幅降低了3D内容创作的门槛。无论是独立游戏制作者、虚拟主播，还是电商展示中的数字人形象，都能借助它快速生成可用资产。
items.summary_en: V2Fun is a 3D character generation tool that uses AI to produce high-quality models with 8K textures and includes AI-powered motion capture for instant animation. What once required a team of professional modelers, texture artists, and expensive motion capture equipment—taking days or weeks—can now be done in minutes. This dramatically lowers the barrier for independent game developers, virtual streamers, and digital human creators in e-commerce, enabling them to quickly generate production-ready characters without specialized skills. It solves the bottleneck of 3D asset creation: speed versus quality.

items.title: Velo 3.0
items.description: AI video infrastructure to explain, train, and sell faster.
items.summary_zh: Velo 3.0是一个AI视频基础设施平台，专为需要快速制作视频内容的企业设计，帮助他们在产品说明、员工培训和市场销售等场景中更高效地传播信息。它整合了视频生成、剪辑、翻译和分发功能，用户只需提供原始材料（如文档、幻灯片或产品演示），AI就能自动生成叙事清晰、画面专业的视频。相比传统视频制作需要编写脚本、拍摄、后期等复杂流程，Velo大幅缩短了视频产出周期。对于销售团队、培训部门和市场营销人员来说，这是一个理想的提效工具。
items.summary_en: Velo 3.0 is an AI-powered video infrastructure platform designed for businesses that need to create video content quickly for explaining products, training employees, or accelerating sales. It integrates video generation, editing, translation, and distribution — users simply provide raw materials like documents, slides, or product demos, and the AI produces professional videos with clear narratives. Compared to traditional video production, which involves scripting, filming, and post-production, Velo drastically reduces turnaround time. Sales teams, training departments, and marketers benefit most, as they can now communicate complex ideas in minutes rather than weeks.

items.title: Fuzzy AI
items.description: We warm your prospects before reaching out
items.summary_zh: Fuzzy AI 是一款销售预热工具，它能在你主动联系潜在客户之前，先通过AI与对方进行自然对话，逐步建立兴趣和信任。解决了冷接触效率低下的痛点是最大亮点，特别是对于B2B销售团队来说，Fuzzy AI 让第一次正式沟通不再尴尬，大幅提高回复率和转化率。
items.summary_en: Fuzzy AI is a prospect warming tool that uses artificial intelligence to engage potential customers in natural conversations before you reach out. It solves the problem of cold outreach by building interest and trust gradually, making the first touchpoint more effective. B2B sales teams benefit most, as Fuzzy AI transforms awkward cold emails into warm, welcomed interactions, significantly boosting reply rates and conversions.

items.title: ZooData
items.description: The data layer for AI agents
items.summary_zh: ZooData 是一个专门为 AI 智能体打造的数据层平台，它解决了智能体在访问和整合多源数据时遇到的碎片化和权限问题。通过提供统一的接口和实时数据流，ZooData 让 AI 代理能够高效地读取、写入和同步来自不同系统的结构化数据，相当于给智能体装上了“数据神经系统”。对于正在构建复杂 AI 工作流的开发者和企业来说，这个工具能大幅减少数据预处理的工作量，让智能体直接“吃”到干净、实时的数据。
items.summary_en: ZooData is a dedicated data layer built specifically for AI agents, addressing the fragmentation and permission headaches that agents face when accessing data from multiple sources. It offers a unified API with real-time data streaming, enabling AI agents to read, write, and sync structured data seamlessly across different systems. Think of it as giving your agent a nervous system for data. For developers and enterprises building complex AI workflows, ZooData cuts down the heavy lifting of data preprocessing, letting agents consume clean, live data directly. This means faster development cycles and more reliable agent behavior.

items.title: Unabyss for Claude
items.description: Shared memory across all apps and LLMs. In Claude
items.summary_zh: Unabyss for Claude 是一款让 Claude 拥有跨应用和跨大模型共享记忆的工具。它能记住你在不同软件和 AI 模型间的对话上下文，不再每次重启都要从头解释。对于重度使用 AI 助手、频繁切换工作场景的用户来说，这解决了记忆碎片化的大痛点，让协作更连贯自然。
items.summary_en: Unabyss for Claude is a tool that gives Claude persistent memory across different apps and large language models. It retains conversation context even when you switch between software or AI assistants, eliminating the need to repeat yourself. This solves the fragmentation problem for heavy AI users who juggle multiple tools, making workflows smoother and more coherent.

items.title: SKI
items.description: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
items.summary_zh: SKI是一款免费语音编程工具，支持Claude Code、Codex等主流AI编程助手，让开发者直接用自然语言口述代码指令，无需动手输入。它解决了程序员因键盘操作导致的肢体疲劳问题，同时也为行动不便的群体提供了更友好的编程方式。最吸引人的是它完全免费，降低了尝试门槛，是追求高效无障碍编程体验者的实用选择。
items.summary_en: SKI is a free voice coding tool that works with popular AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex, letting developers dictate commands and code instructions naturally instead of typing. It addresses common issues like repetitive strain injuries and accessibility barriers, making programming more inclusive and comfortable. The fact that it's free lowers the entry barrier significantly, so anyone curious about hands-free development can simply plug it in and start speaking. For developers with physical discomfort or those just wanting a more ergonomic workflow, SKI offers a practical and approachable solution.

items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.summary_zh: 这篇文章是‘前端转全栈’系列的开篇，专门为初次接触Spring Boot的前端开发者而写。作者从实际工作变化入手，解释了为什么现在前端也需要掌握后端知识，然后引导读者从项目结构、配置文件、启动类等关键入口点开始理解Spring Boot。对于希望突破前端边界、向全栈迈进的前端工程师来说，这是一份贴心的入门指南，能帮你少走弯路。
